en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer released

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI releases its official launch trailer ahead of November 19 arrival in Leonida
entries.summary: Xbox Wire has published the official Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer. The primary-source headline confirms a November 19 arrival and the Leonida setting.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary page was opened. Verified claims are limited to the official launch trailer, Leonida and November 19; no gameplay or platform details have been added beyond the headline.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is now live worldwide
entries.summary: The Xbox Wire primary page confirms that Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched worldwide on October 23.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary page was opened. Its headline directly confirms the worldwide launch; no platform or regional distinctions absent from the packet have been added.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches with over 500 Kill Block map configurations
entries.summary: The launch multiplayer map Kill Block consists of three modular sections that can rearrange between matches and during rounds. It supports 3v3 and the new 10v10 Gunfight at launch, with more than 500 configurations according to the official account.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary feature was opened. The map structure, configuration count and launch modes come from its body text; future support is treated only as planned.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Saros details collaborative boss design: three phases and roughly three to eight minutes per fight
entries.summary: Housemarque handles worldbuilding, combat language and visual direction, while Nixxes handles encounter design, animation, environments and technical implementation. Three-phase boss fights and arena changes encourage players to use shields, jumps, parries and dashes.
entries.verification: The primary developer article on PlayStation Blog was opened. The division of responsibilities, three-phase design principle and typical fight duration all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: 勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。 releases a Steam demo ahead of its planned November 10 full launch
entries.summary: The demo lets players choose one of four "broken" hero companions and progress to the first boss. Transfer of completed demo saves to the full game is planned, with the full release expected on November 10.
entries.verification: The full articles from two independent outlets, 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer, were opened. Both confirm the demo launch; the latter relays the developer/publisher announcement and provides the full-release date and planned save transfer.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Round and Round Inc. announced for a planned November launch
entries.summary: Murbong has announced an incremental game built around welcoming visitors through revolving doors. The goal can scale to admitting 8.2 billion people, with up to 200,000 shown on screen at once.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON video article was opened. The announcement, November window, 8.2-billion-person goal and 200,000-person on-screen limit come from the media report; a primary page was not obtained.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: トロッコ問題は、問題じゃない。 enters Early Access on Steam for PC
entries.summary: This runaway-train roguelite themed around the trolley problem is now in Early Access on Steam for PC. Players can upgrade their train and challenge large bosses.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON video article was opened. Early Access status, the PC Steam platform and gameplay description all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: IGN reports canceled Mass Effect 5 details, including Hitman-style mission freedom
entries.summary: IGN says it verified material disclosed by a former external consultant and obtained additional information from development sources. The canceled project included handcrafted missions, environmental hacking, melee executions and Liara's return, with a story set more than 600 years after the Reaper War.
entries.verification: This is a bounded report from one opened, credible media source. IGN explicitly says it verified the disclosures and cites development sources; the project is described as canceled, not as an upcoming release.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Exodus reveals an updated model for male protagonist Jun Aslan
entries.summary: Archetype has shown an updated character model for Jun Aslan, the selectable male protagonist of Exodus. The report places the change in the context of visual adjustments made in response to player feedback.
entries.verification: The IGN report was opened. The reveal of the updated model is supported by its body text; comments from readers were not treated as facts about the game.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Genshin Impact version 7.2, Hour of Ruin, is scheduled for November 4
entries.summary: miHoYo has announced that version 7.2 will open a new region in eastern Snezhnaya and add two playable characters, Mitya and Valeriy.
entries.verification: The Gematsu report was opened. It explicitly relays developer miHoYo's announcement; the version number, date, new region and characters come from the official information it cites.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Report: Arkane Studios has until November 13 to find a buyer, with around 217 jobs at risk
entries.summary: Citing Le Monde and union representatives, Gematsu reports that Arkane Studios' closure consultation will end on November 13 and that several acquisition options are under consideration. Microsoft separately says it is actively seeking partners to advance Marvel's Blade.
entries.verification: The Gematsu report was opened. The closure deadline and job count come from its relay of Le Monde and union statements. Microsoft confirms only that it is seeking partners; no acquisition outcome is presented as settled.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Troublemaker 3: Fallen Dynasty announced for PC
entries.summary: Gamecom Team has announced the open-world action-comedy beat 'em up sequel. Set three years after Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream, it is intended as the trilogy's conclusion.
entries.verification: The Gematsu report was opened. It relays Gamecom Team's announcement, press release and Steam page, providing an identifiable official chain for the platform and setting.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: 六つ葉探し launches on Steam, challenging players to find one six-leaf clover among over 500,000 clovers
entries.summary: This first-person observation game launched on Steam for PC on October 22. Its central task is to find the single six-leaf clover among four-, five- and six-leaf clovers in a woodland clearing.
entries.verification: The 4Gamer report was opened. The launch date, PC Steam platform and gameplay overview all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Moon Sweepers arrives on Steam with co-op lunar cleaning for up to 16 players
entries.summary: DragDrop Games' new release is now available on Steam for PC. Players work together to collect and sell moon dust, then spend the proceeds on better tools.
entries.verification: The 4Gamer report was opened. The launch platform, support for up to 16 players and core gameplay loop all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: つみみじかん 狂オシイホド愛シテル launched on October 22
entries.summary: This psychological-horror adventure centers on intervening in a former idol's livestream, investigating an abandoned village and searching for a missing idol.
entries.verification: The 4Gamer report was opened. The publisher, October 22 launch and core premise come from its body text; the available evidence did not safely establish a platform.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer creative director puts match quality first
entries.summary: In an IGN interview, Infinity Ward multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot says the team prioritizes match quality. The report also notes that Modern Warfare 4 did not launch with the open-matchmaking option previously offered in Black Ops 7.
entries.verification: The exclusive IGN interview was opened. The interviewee's role, his statement on match quality and the game's launch matchmaking options all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: 鉄廻城砦の灰花 is scheduled to launch on PC on December 18
entries.summary: VISUAL ARTS Scripts has announced that its all-ages visual novel will launch through DLsite and DMM GAMES. The digital edition is priced at 1,200 yen, with a separate first-run limited physical edition.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report was opened. It explicitly relays the brand's October 23 announcement; the date, PC storefronts and price come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Behaviour details indie label Miss Behaviour and its reach through Dead by Daylight
entries.summary: Label head Nathan Sellyn says Miss Behaviour will operate as an indie publishing label distinct from the company's other businesses. It aims to use Dead by Daylight's monthly audience of five to six million players to draw attention to smaller horror games and build lasting credibility as a curator.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's interview with Nathan Sellyn was opened. The label's positioning, company background and monthly-player range are direct statements from the interviewee.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Fate/Grand Order opens the Tamamo Aria event and expands Extra-class Grand slots to four
entries.summary: Following the October 23 update, the event and limited-time Raid began in sequence. Completing the Extra Grand expansion battle increases that class's Grand slots from two Servants to four; Tamamo Aria joins as a Rider.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report was opened. It explicitly attributes the update to FGO PROJECT; the event timing, system changes and new Servant all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Azur Promilia is scheduled for November 26 on PC, iOS and Android
entries.summary: Yostar has announced that the fantasy-world RPG developed by Manjuu Games will be free to play. Gameplay includes bonding with Kibo, exploration, combat and farm management.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report was opened. It explicitly attributes the announcement to Yostar; the date, platforms, business model and developer identity all come from its body text.
entries.timeNote: The source publication time falls within this edition's fixed window.
